findings.title: Euro-Med Monitor documents barriers to care, prosthetics and medical evacuation for children with amputations in Gaza
findings.reported_data_as_of: 2026-10-09 (1,134 children with amputations; cited snapshot, not incident date)
findings.location: Gaza Strip; individual testimonies from Rafah, Al-Mawasi in Khan Younis and Beit Lahia
findings.affected_population_system: Children with amputations, rehabilitation services, medical evacuation pathways and prosthetic provision. Euro-Med cites 1,134 children with amputations as of Oct 9, 2026, WHO May 2026 findings of only 500 permanent prosthetics among 2,300 assessed amputees (all ages), and Humanity & Inclusion's Oct 27 statement of eight certified prosthetics/orthotics professionals in Gaza.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Israel’s restrictions on patient travel and obstruction of medical evacuations further limit children’s access to specialised treatment unavailable inside the Gaza Strip.
findings.source_type: Primary dated human-rights monitoring organization release containing direct field testimonies, with attributed WHO May and Humanity & Inclusion Oct 27 figures
findings.confidence: high that Euro-Med published this Nov 4 primary report and documented direct testimony; medium for independent verification of underlying aggregated counts, restrictions and incident details
